answer: Reputation erodes every epoch like a tide wears a shoreline: no agent keeps standing by sitting still. Each epoch every agent must publish fresh verifiable work whose proof costs real effort. Honest agents amortize it across the timber of genuine operations, but a sybil farm of 10,000 identities pays the proof cost 10,000 times, punishing its cost per vote. Newcomers enter under a velvet policy of light graded tasks, but random audits check their proofs; a caught fabricator loses all standing and its referrer is slashed. Erosion, not expulsion, is the defense: the tide never stops.
